text:
Maria: Quick triage on audit logging coverage for the sprint. Short summary: gateway missing auth.failure events, console missing rbac.change, billing missing invoice.audit entries, runtime missing model.deploy provenance. Need owners + schema tweaks so we can validate customer-facing exports. Can we triage now?

Ashwin: I can take gateway + auth. Quick mapping: gateway currently logs `request.*` but not `auth.*`. I'll open a PR to add `auth.failure` and `auth.success` events. For schema, we should add `actor.type` and `actor.id` fields (consumed by export/alerts).

Tess: I'll own console + billing. Console is missing `rbac.change` and `policy.update` events that customers expect in their audit exports. Billing needs `invoice.view` and `invoice.update` audit events with `customer_id` and a `sensitivity` flag (low|high).

Cheng: Runtime provenance owners here — model.deploy, model.rollback, and image.pull are very sparse. Also when we rewrap artifacts we need KMS key usage events. Suggest adding `kms.key_id` and `kms.operation` to the canonical audit schema.

Maria: Good. Let's agree on a minimal canonical audit event we can ship this sprint. Proposal (short): `event_type`, `timestamp`, `actor:{id,type,ip}`, `target:{id,type}`, `outcome`, `metadata` (map). Keep metadata free-form but avoid secrets.

Samir: +1. Customers explicitly asked for human-readable `actor.display_name` and a `reason` field for RBAC changes. Also: avoid embedding credentials in `metadata`. Docs need an update to call out which fields are included in customer exports.

AuditBot: New backlog tickets created: AS-5123 'Gateway: add auth events' assigned to Ashwin. AS-5124 'Console: RBAC & policy audit events' assigned to Tess. AS-5125 'Runtime: provenance + KMS metadata' assigned to Cheng.

Tess: Quick question — for `actor.type` do we want `service_account` vs `machine` vs `user`? For billing events we might need an `impersonation` boolean too.

Ashwin: yes to types. In gateway logs we currently use `principal.type` — I'll map it to `actor.type` and include enum: [user, service, machine, bot]. My PR will include a migration snippet.

Maria: Action items: Ashwin -> PR for schema + gateway events (AS-5123), Tess -> spec console + billing events (AS-5124), Cheng -> spec runtime + KMS (AS-5125). I'll coordinate a validation harness for customer-facing exports. Owners please add example events for the validator.

Elaine: I can add automated validation to the export pipeline — schema check + redaction rules. ETA EOW?

Cheng: ETA next Tue for the initial spec. Example JSON I'll include in the ticket for the validator: ```json
{"event_type":"model.deploy","timestamp":"2026-03-17T16:20:00Z","actor":{"id":"svc-model","type":"service","display_name":"model-deployer"},"target":{"id":"model-123","type":"model"},"outcome":"success","metadata":{"kms.key_id":"projects/prod/keys/1","image_digest":"sha256:abcd..."}}
```

Maria: One more note: for `rbac.change` events we should avoid huge payload diffs in the event body. Prefer storing a `change_id` that links to a review ticket and include a small `diff_summary` in metadata. Keeps export sizes reasonable.

Samir: +1 to link id approach. Also flag: billing events must be included in at-rest exports for compliance — add retention policy and exportability to the backlog tickets.

Maria: OK will update the sprint board and ping PMs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
